title: Social Hills Half
description:
Planning on ticking the Strava July Half Marathon Challenge? Fancy a longer outing? You are welcome to join me for all, or some, of a Malvern Hills Half route. 
I think this will take 2 3/4 - 3 hours. Below are estimated times for 'jump on' locations. 

08:00  go south from BC on lower trails
08:30 head up from the Wyche bus stop to the Worcestershire Beacon, head round the back of North Hill coming round past Westminster Bank to take lower trails back to the Wyche
9:40 ish take the eastern lower trails back down to BC
10:15 ish head south to the ramparts and possibly the Herefordshire Beacon to complete the 21.1k distance. 

Refreshments in the Malvern Hills Hotel. 

I'm happy to drop anybody back at the Wyche after I have had a cup of coffee!  

Please come prepared with water and nutrition as required for the run. 

If you click in with a plan to participate in only some of the route please message me to let me  know. 

LiRF: Julie S [Phone Number Redacted]
location: British Camp Car Park, Little Malvern, England, United Kingdom
